_about: The words of every failed state in the workspace (src/workspace/failure.ts, drawn by parts/ui/show/screen-state): the plain reasons when Trillion could not be reached, broke, refused, has no owner for the address in the version running (absent, a 404 failure_code no-owner, src/workspace/api.ts), or did not answer a read within api.ts READ_MOST_MS (slow) in words not written for a person (src/workspace/api.ts), `read_kept` (said beside the reason on a refused read's failed state only, since a read changes nothing; the fallbacks themselves never claim an outcome, test/failure-words-gate.test.mjs), `still_opening` (the note a page shows when its cover lifted before the workspace was drawn, src/workspace/opening-cover.mjs), the retry button and what it says while it tries again by itself after each wait in retry_after_ms, the Ask your AI button (chosen: once the person has picked their AI, {label} its name; unchosen: before; choose: the tiles' heading and the small button beside it), the AI connected to their Trillion offered first (connected: its tile, {app} the app's name, connected_unnamed when the app gave none; fix: its button on a failure; do: its button on a screen waiting for something; sent: what is said once it has the job), and ask_prompt, the words handed to an AI: {title} what failed, {page} the page's address, {said} what Trillion answered. A connected AI is handed the job through src/queued-work.json's ask-my-ai row (title: what the person met, request: the words for the AI, page: where). `asks` are screens waiting for something the person's AI can do (an empty screen), by name: its title and the words handed to their AI.
unreached: Trillion could not be reached. Check your connection, then try again.
broke: Trillion had a problem answering. Try again in a moment.
refused: Trillion could not do that just now.
absent: This part of Trillion is not in the version you are running.
slow: Trillion is taking too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
still_opening: Still opening your workspace. Trillion is taking a moment to answer.
pursuits_not_loaded: Your pursuits did not load yet. They show here as soon as Trillion answers.
ask_prompt: Something in Trillion did not work and I want your help. What failed: {title}. Where: {page}. What Trillion answered: {said}. Use your Trillion connection to check what happened and fix it or do it another way. If you are not connected to Trillion yet, help me connect first.
